description: Land Acquisition - Kaddukarankudiyiruppu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details) that are being acquired for public purposes. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a clear Land Gazette.
